note: Phase-1 recorded-fixture baseline (D13-a). The CI eval-gate fails a PR whose overall intent accuracy drops >2pp below this. Re-record fixtures (scripts/record_fixtures.py) and bump this number when the prompt/model legitimately improves; nightly live runs (Anthropic/OpenAI) catch silent model drift.
recording_note: Re-recorded under prompt v3 (roadmap 2.7) by running the first-pass model over the 56-case golden set with escalation pinned off, so this measures the cheap tier the way every inbound message pays for it. Measured 0.9821 (55/56); the one miss is a borderline general_info-vs-property_question case ('where is the nearest supermarket') the model labelled property_question at 0.78 — below the escalation threshold, so it re-runs on the larger model in production rather than acting on the cheap guess. Franco-Arabic cases were added to the golden set in the same pass; the model handled all six. The prompt fingerprint above is what actually distinguishes two runs when the version string agrees (PROMPT_VERSION only moves when a human moves it).
